## Type of change

- [ ] Fix a broken / moved link
- [ ] Add a resource (tool, talk, paper, course, community)
- [ ] Update a regulation / standard / date
- [ ] Improve wording or fix a typo
- [ ] Add / improve a template or checklist
- [ ] Other (describe below)

## Checklist

- [ ] Links point to primary sources where possible and all resolve
- [ ] No exploit payloads or weaponization steps added
- [ ] Vendor-neutral, describes what a resource is *for*
- [ ] Matches the existing style and structure
- [ ] One focused change per PR
